Alin: Quick sync — Orchid Health evaluation. Need to lock scope + success criteria by EOD Fri. Primary flow: ingest patient notes -> redact PHI -> summarize + action-items. Who owns integration plan (SDK, auth, quotas, streaming)?
Mira: I can own SDK + auth. Will add Node/Python examples and mTLS notes. Do they need streaming for live note-taking or just batch?
Sam: From presales, they want near-realtime summaries for 50 concurrent clinicians. Recommend starting quotas: 10 qps sustained, 60 qps burst, token cap 1M/day for trial. Pricing: we can provide a 30-day eval credit + 20% pilot discount. @Alin confirm.
Francine: Uploaded security questionnaire answers here: https://drive.redwood/secure/orchid-qsa. They require EU data residency + KMS. Private deployment likely — need SOW.
Jordan: For success criteria propose: p95 latency <200ms per token for streaming, summary ROUGE-L >0.75 vs labeled gold, PHI redaction recall >95%. Timeline: 2wk integration, 1wk eval.
Alin: Customer wants canary rollout to 50 clinicians on week 3. Mira/Sam/Francine — can you confirm owners + blockers? I'll prep commercial terms after scope.
Mira: I'll post SDK snippets today. Sample curl for quick test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-1.2","input":"patient note...","stream":true}'
```
Sam: Implementation notes: use idempotency-key header for retries, exponential backoff with jitter. Streaming uses SSE/JSON-lines; client should handle partial tokens. Quotas are enforced per API key + org.
Francine: Logs & audit: we can enable encrypted audit export to customer's S3. Need PO to allow >90d retention and KMS key access. Also confirm that PHI redaction runs client-side or server-side.
Jordan: I'll drop the labeled eval set + prompt templates in the shared folder by EOD. Also recommend automated regression checks in Redwood Optimize.
oncall-bot: NOTE: demo environment will be rotated 2026-02-10T03:00:00Z — expect a short outage during refresh.
Alin: Great — next steps: Mira upload SDK PR, Sam finalize quota & pricing estimate, Francine confirm deployment model + SOW ask, Jordan upload evals. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thursday. Thanks :raised_hands:
